### 1.1-1.5 Problem Analysis

**Problem Restatement:** The `dvc move` command fails to properly rename the associated `.dvc` stage file when moving data files that have suffixes (extensions) in their filenames.

**Technical Details:**
- **File names involved:** `foo`, `foo.csv`, `bar`, `bar.csv`
- **Stage files:** `foo.dvc`, `foo.csv.dvc`, `bar.dvc`, `bar.csv.dvc`
- **Commands:** `dvc add`, `dvc move`
- **Method/Function:** Likely in the move command implementation

**Clear Problem Statement:**
When using `dvc move` on a file with an extension (like `foo.csv` → `bar.csv`), DVC should rename the corresponding stage file from `foo.csv.dvc` to `bar.csv.dvc`. However, it currently fails to do this renaming, leaving the old stage file in place and not creating the new one.

**Reproduction Steps:**
1. Create a file with an extension: `echo foo > foo.csv`
2. Add it to DVC: `dvc add foo.csv` (creates `foo.csv.dvc`)
3. Move the file: `dvc move foo.csv bar.csv`
4. Observe that `bar.csv.dvc` is not created and `foo.csv.dvc` still exists

**Best Practices for Testing/Fixing:**
- Understand DVC's file-to-stage mapping logic
- Test with various file extensions
- Ensure the fix handles edge cases
- Maintain backward compatibility
- Test both simple and complex filenames

    29	
    30	**Data Science Version Control** or **DVC** is an **open-source** tool for data science and
    31	machine learning projects. With a simple and flexible Git-like architecture and interface it
    32	helps data scientists:
    33	
    34	#. manage **machine learning models** - versioning, including data sets and transformations (scripts) that were
    35	   used to generate models;
    36	
    37	#. make projects **reproducible**;
    38	
    39	#. make projects **shareable**;
    40	
    41	#. manage experiments with branching and **metrics** tracking;
    42	
    43	It aims to replace tools like Excel and Docs that are being commonly used as a knowledge repo and
    44	a ledger for the team, ad-hoc scripts to track and move deploy different model versions, ad-hoc
    45	data file suffixes and prefixes.
    46	
    47	.. contents:: **Contents**
    48	  :backlinks: none
    49	
    50	How DVC works
    51	=============
    52	
    53	DVC is compatible with Git for storing code and the dependency graph (DAG), but not data files cache.
    54	To store and share data files cache DVC supports remotes - any cloud (S3, Azure, Google Cloud, etc) or any on-premise
    55	network storage (via SSH, for example).
    56

    58	   :target: https://dvc.org/static/img/flow.gif
    59	   :alt: how_dvc_works

    61	Quick start
    62	===========
    63	
    64	Please read `Get Started <https://dvc.org/doc/get-started>`_ for the full version. Common workflow commands include:
    65	
    66	+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
    67	| Step                              | Command                                                           |
    68	+===================================+===================================================================+
    69	| Track code and data together      | | ``$ git add train.py``                                          |
    70	|                                   | | ``$ dvc add images.zip``                                        |
    71	+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
    72	| Connect code and data by commands | | ``$ dvc run -d images.zip -o images/ unzip -q images.zip``      |
    73	|                                   | | ``$ dvc run -d images/ -d train.py -o model.p python train.py`` |
    74	+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
    75	| Make changes and reproduce        | | ``$ vi train.py``                                               |
    76	|                                   | | ``$ dvc repro model.p.dvc``                                     |
    77	+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
    78	| Share code                        | | ``$ git add .``                                                 |
    79	|                                   | | ``$ git commit -m 'The baseline model'``                        |
    80	|                                   | | ``$ git push``                                                  |
    81	+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
    82	| Share data and ML models          | | ``$ dvc remote add myremote s3://mybucket/image_cnn``           |
    83	|                                   | | ``$ dvc config core.remote myremote``                           |
    84	|                                   | | ``$ dvc push``                                                  |
    85	+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+

    87	Installation
    88	============
    89	
    90	There are three options to install DVC: ``pip``, Homebrew, or an OS-specific package:
    91	
    92	pip (PyPI)
    93	----------
    94	
    95	Stable
    96	^^^^^^
    97	.. code-block:: bash
    98	
    99	   pip install dvc
   100	
   101	Development
   102	^^^^^^^^^^^
   103	.. code-block:: bash
   104	
   105	   pip install git+git://github.com/iterative/dvc
   106	
   107	Homebrew
   108	--------
   109	
   110	.. code-block:: bash
   111	
   112	   brew install iterative/homebrew-dvc/dvc
   113	
   114	or:
   115	
   116	.. code-block:: bash
   117	
   118	   brew cask install iterative/homebrew-dvc/dvc

   120	Package
   121	-------
   122	
   123	Self-contained packages for Windows, Linux, Mac are available. The latest version of the packages can be found at
   124	GitHub `releases page <https://github.com/iterative/dvc/releases>`_.
   125	
   126	Ubuntu / Debian (apt)
   127	^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
   128	.. code-block:: bash
   129	
   130	   sudo wget https://dvc.org/deb/dvc.list -O /etc/apt/sources.list.d/dvc.list
   131	   sudo apt-get update
   132	   sudo apt-get install dvc
   133	
   134	Fedora / CentOS (rpm)
   135	^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
   136	.. code-block:: bash
   137	
   138	   sudo wget https://dvc.org/rpm/dvc.repo -O /etc/yum.repos.d/dvc.repo
   139	   sudo yum update
   140	   sudo yum install dvc

   143	^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
   144	*Unofficial package*, any inquiries regarding the AUR package,

   147	.. code-block:: bash
   148	
   149	   yay -S dvc

   151	Related technologies
   152	====================
   153	
   154	#. `Git-annex <https://git-annex.branchable.com/>`_ - DVC uses the idea of storing the content of large files (that you
   155	   don't want to see in your Git repository) in a local key-value store and uses file hardlinks/symlinks instead of the
   156	   copying actual files.
   157	
   158	#. `Git-LFS <https://git-lfs.github.com/>`_ - DVC is compatible with any remote storage (S3, Google Cloud, Azure, SSH,
   159	   etc). DVC utilizes reflinks or hardlinks to avoid copy operation on checkouts which makes much more efficient for
   160	   large data files.
   161	
   162	#. *Makefile* (and its analogues). DVC tracks dependencies (DAG).
   163	
   164	#. `Workflow Management Systems <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Workflow_management_system>`_. DVC is a workflow
   165	   management system designed specifically to manage machine learning experiments. DVC is built on top of Git.
